article.title: ChatGPT聊天頁開始推出GPT-6.2，Work與Codex模型維持原樣
article.title_en: GPT-6.2 starts rolling out in ChatGPT Chat; Work and Codex stay unchanged
article.summary: OpenAI於11月23日宣布，為聊天頁調整的GPT-6.2版本開始向四類付費方案逐步推出。
article.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out a chat-tuned version of GPT-6.2 to four paid ChatGPT tiers on November 23.
highlights: 涵蓋Plus、Pro、Business及Enterprise；企業接入仍依管理員設定。
聊天頁採用GPT-6.2 Sol的調整版本，本次不更改Work或Codex模型。
highlights_en: The rollout covers Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise, subject to enterprise admin settings.
Chat uses a version of GPT-6.2 Sol; this release does not change Work or Codex models.
article.why: 以Chat整理旅遊、產品或市場資料的團隊，可重新檢視多條件比較的輸出；Work既有流程的表現不應歸因於這次更新。
article.why_en: Teams researching travel, products or markets in Chat can reassess multi-constraint comparisons without attributing Work results to this update.
article.next_step: 用同一份酒店價格、地點及客群要求，比對聊天頁的新回覆與既有範本，逐項檢查遺漏條件及來源。
article.next_step_en: Compare Chat responses against an existing hotel brief with fixed price, location and audience requirements, checking omissions and sources.
article.detail: OpenAI表示此版本改善複雜指令、網上資料搜尋及圖片理解，這些屬公司對模型能力的描述。公告列出的例子包括按價格及地點比較酒店，以及提出後續價格提醒。團隊可把這些任務拆成明確驗收條件，確認帳戶已收到更新後再比較結果；逐步推出並不代表每個帳戶同時可用。
article.detail_en: OpenAI describes improvements in complex instructions, web research and image understanding. Its examples include hotel trade-offs and follow-up price reminders. These are company capability claims. Define acceptance criteria and confirm the account has received the rollout before comparing results; access is gradual.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
